title: Application of Western Massachusetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 896, for approval by the Department of Public utilities of a semi-annual fuel charge as adopted in D.P.U. 95-8A to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of December, 1997, January and February, 1998. Application is also made by Western Massachusetts Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 586 during the same time period. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
